en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small rocky seaside harbor with a narrow concrete walkway and stone walls. Several rowboats lie in a sheltered inlet, and a larger sailing boat is moored at a pier where many people are gathered. Low wooded islands are visible in the background. A white wooden building with flags stands on the left. Printed caption text appears in the lower left, and a publisher's mark with a number is in the lower right.
